name: AFFiNE
description: There can be more than Notion and Miro. AFFiNE(pronounced [ə'fain]) is a next-gen knowledge base that brings planning, sorting and creating all together. Privacy first, open-source, customizable and ready to use.
one_liner: A combined notes-and-whiteboard app, like Notion and Miro fused together, that you can run yourself so your documents never have to leave your own computer.
buyer: A privacy-conscious small business or professional, like a therapist or lawyer, who needs a Notion-style workspace but isn't allowed to put client notes on someone else's cloud server.
business_use_cases: An IT consultant offers a 'private workspace setup' service, self-hosting it for law firms, clinics, and other regulated small businesses.
A privacy-focused software reseller bundles it with managed hosting and support as an alternative to paying for Notion seats.
A design or product team runs it internally to combine project docs and visual brainstorming without sending IP to a third-party SaaS.

money_ideas.idea: A managed self-hosting and support subscription for privacy-regulated small businesses
One-off migration service moving a team off Notion/Miro onto a self-hosted instance

steal_this: Set up a hosted instance for one privacy-sensitive local business this weekend (a therapist, a lawyer) and charge a flat monthly fee for hosting plus support.
